subject.title: [Feature]: Slack Block Kit support for agent messages

question: Should this umbrella remain open for a documented Slack-native producer/reporting boundary, or should it close because raw Slack blocks plus portable presentation are the supported solution?
rationale: Current main has the core delivery seams, but choosing whether to bless advanced Slack-specific producer APIs, auto-conversion, or richer report/table layouts is a product/API direction call.

options.title: Keep Boundary Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide and document the supported Slack-native rich-output producer boundary.

options.title: Close As Satisfied
options.body: Close after documenting that raw Slack blocks and portable presentation are the supported paths and rich_text/table auto-conversion is not planned.

options.title: Split A Narrow Follow-Up
options.body: Close this umbrella only after selecting or opening one canonical follow-up for Slack-native report/table/rich_text support.

recommendation.title: Keep Boundary Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide and document the supported Slack-native rich-output producer boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and authored several merged Slack Block Kit slices tied directly to this issue.
